We are seeking a highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Boomi Integration Engineer to lead the design, development, and maintenance of integration solutions across our enterprise systems. This role is instrumental in driving end-to-end system integration, process automation, and data flow optimization using the Boomi platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in integration architecture and middleware best practices, with the ability to work cross-functionally and deliver scalable and secure integrations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
8+ years of experience in system integration, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Boomi
Strong experience in integration with enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, HRIS, etc.)
Solid understanding of APIs (REST/SOAP), authentication mechanisms (OAuth, SAML), and secure data exchange
r: Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of complex integrations using Boomi.
Collaborate with business analysts, application owners, and other stakeholders to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Develop and maintain integrations between cloud-based and on-premise systems, including ERPs (e.g., SAP, Oracle), HR systems (e.g., SuccessFactors), CRMs, MS AD, APIs, and third-party platforms.
Define and enforce standards, patterns, and best practices for integration development and maintenance.
Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and security of deployed integrations using Boomi monitoring tools and dashboards.
Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues efficiently, ensuring minimal business disruption.

d: The position is responsible to provide support to the internal brand team for all their inbound and outbound shipments and also to ensure that the shipments are customs cleared and delivered on time to the warehouse and the stores using the most cost-effective means.
Establishing contact with the Supplier/ Agent for cargo pick up post aligning with the Brand team.
Coordinate with freight forwarder to arrange collection for Import & re-export and follow up till goods delivery at the warehouse / Stores.
Invite freight quotes from various service providers and prepare comparisons for ADHOC shipments.
Facilitate the movement of stocks (Inbound & Outbound) using the most cost-efficient means of transport, at the earliest possible lead time.
Generate shipping documents for outbound shipments to GCC and local exports to UAE.
Validate all customs BOE & freight invoices and handover to finance for payment process in a timely manner so that shipments are not impacted.
Process BOE & making customs duty payments for all inbound and outbound shipments.
Brand Manager/Merchandiser/Logistics Executive, Dubai Customs, Dubai Trade, Manager – Central Logistics etc.
At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through, our global hub in Dubai; and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers ‘Fly Better’.

Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting-edge information and technology team as a Senior Technical Software Engineer - Java.

The Senior Technical Software Engineer - Java, is a fully participating member of an agile feature team who works independently on software development and problem resolution. The role involves technical design, software development, implementation, and maintenance of software solutions/products that support the Emirates Group Business.
q: Degree or Honours (12+3 or equivalent) in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Computational Mathematics, Computer Engineering or Software Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of experience in application development using Java (versions 8, 11, or 17) with Spring Boot and familiarity with code quality tools such as SonarQube and ShiftLeft.
Strong expertise in Java frameworks and libraries including Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring WebFlux, JPA, Hibernate, and test frameworks (JUnit/TestNG).
Experience with front-end technologies such as ReactJS and NextJS for building user interfaces.
Proficiency in messaging and integration technologies including Solace, Tibco, and Kafka, and familiarity with Netflix OSS components.
Hands-on experience with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift, and knowledge of hybrid cloud architecture (AWS, Azure).
Database expertise in Oracle SQL or similar RDBMS, NoSQL databases, and building RESTful API services.
Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps principles with experience in lean software development, test-driven development, and automated deployments.
Ability to design and implement event-driven architectures, reactive programming solutions, and scalable systems following SRE principles and code review best practices.
Experience in technology evaluation, vendor selection, and managing technology platforms for DevOps including data pipelines, code management, and continuous integration/deployment.
Excellent problem-solving skills, agile development experience, and ability to provide production support for business-critical applications.

Join the Product Engineering team, where we are hiring talented software engineers to develop and support a diverse range of applications that power the growth of Emirates Airlines and the Group. Our business interests span passenger services, airport and ground operations, crew and network operations, air cargo sales and operations, and holiday and leisure products and services on a global scale. If you are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technologies to support diverse and large-scale operations, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the continued success and innovation at Emirates Group.
Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotels stays around the world.
Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers.
r: Collaborate with the team to deliver technical design, development and deployment of complex solutions within relevant product. Carry out effective technical design reviews to ensure that the right architecture patterns are used by the team.

Drive the adoption of Engineering practices , implement development process automation, lean software development, built-in-quality, test driven development, agile practices, and timely root cause analysis and blameless incident post-mortems.

Partner with cross-functional teams to determine viability of solutions. Evaluate current problems, future requirements and existing solutions in medium to large projects to enable high level design and drive proof-of-concepts and implement prototypes to validate ideas.

Investigate, debug and fix complex issues involving corner cases and rare conditions. Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and new technologies and presenting these for architectural review.
Contribute to sprint/work design and planning by providing subject matter expertise on business domain and relevant technologies and actively contribute to technology specific community of practices.

Manage and mentor Software Engineers to allow for skill/knowledge development through advice, coaching, and training opportunities. Responsible for their technical deliveries and adherence to design and coding standards and practices.
Ensure optimal use of enterprise application platforms, tools and libraries in line with the approved technology architecture.
Responsible for corrective, adaptive, preventative and perfective maintenance of products in collaboration with other capabilities for the relevant product.
